workload: device emulation end to end from the same OpenQASM source: IBM = qiskit.transpile(backend=FakeBoston/FakeMiami, optimization_level=1, seed 0) + AerSimulator.from_backend (Aer's automatic method); Google = Cirq RouteCQC on willow_pink + CZTargetGateset + qsim (QSimSimulator with NoiseModelFromGoogleNoiseProperties) or Cirq DensityMatrixSimulator (google_dm); QPUTwin = one HTTP job (SABRE seed 0, calibrated noise, engine auto). Per-device simulator objects are built outside the timed region. hellinger = predicted Hellinger fidelity to the exact ideal output
